_description: Deterministic manual-entry input set for the no-op A/B, recorded against the deal-type-first entry flow introduced by d1bfd2d (2026-08-20). It REPLACES STAGE_11C_NOOP_INPUTS.json as the harness's live fixture: that set was recorded 2026-08-14 against a 'Manual Entry' button the 08-20 commit removed, and 10 of its 20 fields (companyAShares/EPS/currentSharePriceA, the B-side equivalents, offerPricePerShare) no longer exist as form inputs on any entry path. STAGE_11C is retained as the historical record of the 11-C gate, not as a runnable fixture.
_why_private: The gate's whole premise is that identical inputs produce an identical deck, so a byte diff isolates CODE from DATA. Only the private paths ('Neither is listed' / 'Listed acquirer, private target') still accept typed fundamentals; 'Public → Public' is ticker-only, and a ticker fetch is live market data — exactly the drift that made the frozen live baseline (STAGE_11A_BASELINE.json) useless. So the deterministic flow is privpriv, and the captured deck is the PRIVATE shape.
_coverage: privpriv yields hasMarketData:false, so DeckShell suppresses equity / analyst / exchangeratio and promotes privatevaluation + contribution: 16 PDF sections, not the public 17. The three suppressed sections are NOT covered by this gate, and privatevaluation + creditstats are covered only here. Closing that gap needs a stubbed /api/quote (deterministic public fetch) — see README.
_values: A-side/B-side fundamentals carry over from STAGE_11C where the field still exists, so the deck is populated to a comparable degree. offerValueTotal replaces offerPricePerShare (a private target has no per-share price). Figures are arbitrary but FIXED — realism is irrelevant to a byte diff; identity across runs is the only requirement.
